# Data Preparation at Scale: Contracts, Synthetic Data and Privacy

> Contract and link several data producers, prepare 30 million rows idempotently on a laptop, and release health data only after measuring its utility and its risk. SDAIA Academy course DS-405, version 2027.2.0, in English.

Each slide is a heading such as "#### [day1#slide-id] Title": cite slides by that id, and each citation is a link (slides/day1.html#slide-id). These files are what a trainee sees: no speaker notes and no answer keys.

## Course

- [Course page](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-405/index.md): overview, outcomes, schedule and labs; the page itself is https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-405/index.html
- [The whole course](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-405/llms-full.txt): every unit, session and slide in one file, about 18,864 tokens
- [Practice questions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-405/practice.html): questions to check yourself, with feedback after each answer

## Slides

- [Day 1: Contract the producers](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-405/slides/day1.md): Three producers, one contract, one linkage key, one change policy; sessions: Preparation breaks where producers disagree, One contract, three producers, Linking patients across producers, Versions and breaking changes; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-405/slides/day1.html; about 4,806 tokens
- [Day 2: Prepare at scale](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-405/slides/day2.md): Thirty million rows on a laptop, loaded once, rebuilt exactly, gated per partition; sessions: Columnar files and lazy execution, Incremental and idempotent loads, Tables with history, Gates and lineage at scale; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-405/slides/day2.html; about 4,906 tokens
- [Day 3: Synthesise and attack](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-405/slides/day3.md): Synthetic patients and encounters, measured for utility and attacked for privacy; sessions: When synthetic data fits, Generating related tables, Utility is measured against the analysis, Privacy is measured by attack; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-405/slides/day3.html; about 3,833 tokens
- [Day 4: Protect and decide](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-405/slides/day4.md): Longitudinal risk, a budget over twelve releases, pooling without pooling, and the decision; sessions: Disclosure risk in longitudinal records, Privacy budgets over many releases, Analysis without pooling records, The release decision; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-405/slides/day4.html; about 3,880 tokens
- [Capstone: Capstone: a release package and its defence](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-405/slides/capstone.md): Ten minutes each, questions included: the package, its measured results and one attack re-run live; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-405/slides/capstone.html; about 952 tokens

## Labs

- [Lab 1.1: Profile three producers](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-405/labs/D1_1_profile_producers.ipynb): Day 1, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 1.2: One contract for three producers](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-405/labs/D1_2_shared_contract.ipynb): Day 1, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 1.3: A keyed linkage identifier](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-405/labs/D1_3_keyed_linkage.ipynb): Day 1, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 1.4: A breaking-change policy, tested](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-405/labs/D1_4_breaking_changes.ipynb): Day 1, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 2.1: From eager to lazy](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-405/labs/D2_1_lazy_columnar.ipynb): Day 2, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 2.2: Load one day twice](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-405/labs/D2_2_idempotent_load.ipynb): Day 2, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 2.3: Rebuild last month](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-405/labs/D2_3_table_snapshots.ipynb): Day 2, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 2.4: Gates and lineage per partition](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-405/labs/D2_4_gates_lineage.ipynb): Day 2, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 3.1: Four requests, three options](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-405/labs/D3_1_choose_method.ipynb): Day 3, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 3.2: Two generators for related tables](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-405/labs/D3_2_relational_generators.ipynb): Day 3, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 3.3: Train on synthetic, test on real](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-405/labs/D3_3_synthetic_utility.ipynb): Day 3, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 3.4: Attack each synthetic table](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-405/labs/D3_4_attack_synthetic.ipynb): Day 3, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 4.1: Sequences as quasi-identifiers](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-405/labs/D4_1_longitudinal_risk.ipynb): Day 4, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 4.2: Twelve months, one budget](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-405/labs/D4_2_budget_ledger.ipynb): Day 4, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 4.3: A pooled rate without pooled records](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-405/labs/D4_3_secure_aggregation.ipynb): Day 4, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 4.4: The decision for the university](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-405/labs/D4_4_release_decision.ipynb): Day 4, Session 4, 25 min
